verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims automation of invoice approval and payments, and mentions procurement approval flows. The Payments API shows it can send ACH, wires, and checks, so an approval-to-payment flow plausibly exists. But nothing documents assigning approval permissions to designated teammates or a one-click approve-and-send action. missing for 10: documented role/permission configuration for payment approvers, evidence of one-click approve-and-send, in-depth first-party docs on bill-pay approval workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
